spike: S1 Track A — official Figma MCP extraction

mcp_server.name: figma
mcp_server.auth: OAuth browser flow (one-time, cached) — confirmed LIVE this session

extraction_tools.name: mcp__figma__get_metadata
extraction_tools.purpose: Structural overview of a node/page in XML: node IDs, layer types, names, positions, sizes. No styles/values. Used to discover child node IDs to drill into.

params.nodeId: optional string ^\d+[:-]\d+$ — omit to list top-level pages (guid+name)

extraction_tools.name: mcp__figma__get_design_context
extraction_tools.purpose: PRIMARY design-to-code tool. Returns reference code + screenshot + contextual metadata + asset download URLs. Uses Code Connect if mapped.

params.forceCode: optional bool — return code even if large (else metadata-only fallback)

extraction_tools.returns: code string + assets JSON (download URLs) + screenshot (default)

extraction_tools.name: mcp__figma__get_variable_defs
extraction_tools.purpose: Variable (design token) definitions for a node, e.g. {'icon/default/secondary': '#949494'}. Covers fonts, colors, sizes, spacings.

params.nodeId: required string ^\d+[:-]\d+$ — requires concrete node target

extraction_tools.name: mcp__figma__get_screenshot
extraction_tools.purpose: Render PNG of a node. Returns short-lived URL + curl by default (token-cheap); base64 inline only if enableBase64Response.
extraction_tools.returns: short-lived URL + curl instructions + metadata (width/height, original_width/original_height); optional inline base64

other_figma_tools_present_not_used: generate_figma_design (write tools — out of scope, read-only spike)
notes: Track A = official MCP called directly by Claude Code (not Agno, not PAT). Read-only. nodeId regex accepts both 216-152 and 216:152 forms.
